tasks.label: Diagnose mirror connectivity
args: const dns=require('dns').promises; const targets=['all.api.radio-browser.info','de1.api.radio-browser.info']; (async()=>{ for(const host of targets){ try{ const a=await dns.resolve4(host); console.log(host,'A',a); }catch(e){ console.log(host,'A_ERR',e.code||e.message); } try{ const aaaa=await dns.resolve6(host); console.log(host,'AAAA',aaaa); }catch(e){ console.log(host,'AAAA_ERR',e.code||e.message); } } const urls=['https://all.api.radio-browser.info/json/stations/search?limit=1','https://de1.api.radio-browser.info/json/stations/search?limit=1']; for(const url of urls){ try{ const r=await fetch(url,{headers:{accept:'application/json'}}); console.log('FETCH_OK',url,r.status); const t=await r.text(); console.log('BODY_HEAD',t.slice(0,120).replace(/\s+/g,' ')); }catch(e){ console.log('FETCH_ERR',url,e.name,e.code||'',e.message); if(e.cause) console.log('CAUSE',e.cause.code||'',e.cause.message||String(e.cause)); } } })();

args: echo '--- proxy env ---'; env | grep -i 'proxy' || true; echo '--- curl test ---'; curl -I --max-time 6 'https://de1.api.radio-browser.info/json/stations/search?limit=1' || true
